units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 6:1">Esth. R. to III, 9</cite> <he>עד … ר׳ בשינה</he> how long yet will (you) the fathers of the world be sunk in sleep?

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:8">Pes. X, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 120b:3">120ᵇ</cite>) <he>נִרְדְּמוּ לא וכ׳</he> if they have been fast asleep, at the end of the Passover meal, they dare not eat again, opp. <he>נתנמנמו</he>. Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Leviticus 8">Vayikra 8</cite> <he>יונה</he> … <he>נ׳ וישן</he> Jonah, in the anguish of his soul, was overcome and fell asleep.
<cite ref="Leviticus 8">Ib.</cite> <he>אנו … ואתה נִרְדָּם</he> we are standing between life and death, and thou art asleep?
